sources.author: Sayyid Quṭb
sources.title: Fī ẓilāl al-Qurʾān
sources.source_notes: Copyrighted modern work. quran-tafsir.net serves it openly per ayah (slug 'qotb'); only S1 and 86-114 were fetched. OpenITI also has 1386SayyidQutb.FiZilalQuran.Tafsir07053-ara1 (446,925 chars, i.e. a small part of the book) — not fetched. Pages fetched ok: 312/312; consecutive identical pages (one passage served under each ayah of a verse group) are stored once as a..a_end.

sources.author: Muḥammad ʿAbduh
sources.title: Tafsīr al-Qurʾān al-karīm: Juzʾ ʿAmma
sources.limitation: No locally held corpus text; memory fallback forbidden.
sources.source_notes: Not in OpenITI (RELEASE 2025-1-9 has only Risālat al-tawḥīd and the Nahj al-balāgha commentary by ʿAbduh), and not on quran-tafsir.net's book list. First printed Cairo 1322/1904 (al-Manār); the author died 1905, so the text is out of copyright, but no free digital text was located in this pass (archive.org search 2026-10-03: no matching item). shamela.ws search answered HTTP 403 to a scripted request (2026-10-03), so Shamela availability is not verified.
